notes: Exalted: The Autochthonians supplied and intake in progress. 126 rows reviewed and inventoried under docs/references/exalted1e/alchemical/inventory/: the Chapter Two character-creation overview (plus bonus-point/experience-cost tables), the universal Anima Effect/Anima Banner table, the Alchemical Physiology section (Artificial Metabolism, Life and Death, Refitting/Essence Advancement/Evolution), all five Castes (Orichalcum, Moonsilver, Jade, Starmetal, Soulsteel) plus the apocryphal Adamant Caste sidebar, the full Clarity Trait (gain/loss/effects table) and its Dissonance/Gremlin Syndrome mirror, the new/altered Backgrounds (Class, Vats, Artifact, Backing, Familiar, Manse) plus the Building Vats in Creation sidebar and the Followers/Influence/Resources exclusion note, and all of Chapter Three (pp. 87-141/PDF 88-142): the Charm-system framing (Charm Slots/Panoplies/Submodules/Arrays, Designing New Charms, Eclipse/Moonshadow access, Charm format/limitations), the two General Charms, and the complete Close Combat, Ranged Combat, Might and Mobility, Social, Stealth and Disguise, Sensory and Spiritual, Medical, Cognitive, and Essence and Weaving Charm trees (94 Charms total plus the Alchemical Martial Artists and Identifying Charms sidebars), ending with the Man-Machine Weaving Engine and God-Machine Weaving Engine Charms that close out the chapter. Nothing promoted to a production catalog yet. The full Alchemical weaving-protocol catalog (Chapter Four, pp. 145-159/PDF 146-160 per an in-book cross-reference), the rest of Chapter Four (Miracles of the Machine God), and Chapters Five through Seven (the three adventure chapters) are not yet inventoried. Locked pending the remaining inventory, schema/rules/creator/editor implementation, and passing tests across all five planned families.
